history_summary.value: The Ardennaise is a traditional breed of the Ardennes plateau spanning Belgium and France, first described in 1882. It nearly disappeared by 1940 after crossbreeding with Leghorn stock, and was gradually rebuilt over about three decades following the Second World War.
